ingredients.raw: 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano or Italian herbs
ingredients.name: dried oregano

ingredients.raw: 1 (15 ounce) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: cannellini beans

ingredients.raw: 1 large bunch kale, ribs removed and leaves chopped
ingredients.name: kale

ingredients.raw: 1 rotisserie chicken, skin removed and meat shredded
ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken

instructions.text: Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add drained cannellini beans and toss to coat; marinate at least 30 minutes or overnight.
Prepare dressing by stirring together mayonnaise, ketchup, relish, white wine vinegar, garlic powder, and onion powder in a small bowl.
Season dressing with salt and pepper; cover and refrigerate until ready to use.
Chop kale and add to a large salad bowl with a pinch of salt.
Massage kale with clean hands 10 times until leaves become slightly wet and darker.
Shred rotisserie chicken meat, dice cucumber, and chop Gruyère cheese.
Add chicken, cucumber, Gruyère, and marinated beans to the massaged kale.
Portion salad and dress with thousand island immediately before serving.
